notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two mana-producing lands and/or creatures, one of which must be able to produce at least {G}.
description:
At the beginning of the next upkeep, Awakening triggers.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing lands and creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Awakening's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Awakening's trigger, untapping all lands and creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
